verdict.rationale: Logseq describes itself as an open-source knowledge base, and community users independently confirm it is open source with source available, which covers reading its source under an open license. The evidence is thin, though: it never names the license or points to the source repository. Missing for 10: the specific open license named (e.g. AGPL/MIT), a documented link to the product's source code repository.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: Logseq: A privacy-first, open-source knowledge base
Putting up with it because it's improving and open source.
no mandatory subscription, local data, and source availability
